09:00.headline: Best fit beats biggest name
09:00.topic: Use his numbers vs. typical ranges by level to pick target levels (best-fit preview)
09:00.caption:
Is your player chasing a name on a jersey, or a place where he'll actually play?

A lot of families aim at the biggest program first and work backward. It's often smarter to start with his numbers.

⚾ Compare his exit velo, 60 time, velo or pop time with typical ranges at D1, D2, D3, NAIA and JUCO
⚾ Notice where he's already in range, not just where he's close
⚾ Build his target list around the levels where he fits

Best fit beats biggest name. A free best-fit preview is a simple place to start. (Fit scores are estimates, not a coach's evaluation.)

Where do you think his numbers fit today?

13:00.headline: What's in his full report
13:00.topic: What the full report includes: level comparison, target list, 90-day plan, coach PDFs
13:00.caption:
Ever wish you had one clear plan instead of a pile of recruiting advice?

That's what the full BaseballFuture report is built for. It turns your player's numbers into next steps:

✅ His numbers compared with typical ranges for D1, D2, D3, NAIA and JUCO
✅ A school target list built around his best fit
✅ A 90-day plan for what to work on next
✅ PDFs you can send to college coaches

It won't promise a roster spot, and nothing honest can. It helps you spend your time and money on the right schools.
